components.name: Alert / symptom
components.description: User impact or SLO signal triggers investigation

components.name: API resources + events
components.description: Check desired state, status, scheduling and recent events

components.name: Node + kubelet
components.description: Inspect Ready condition, pressure and runtime

components.name: Pod logs + probes
components.description: Check current / previous logs and health checks

components.name: Network + storage
components.description: Trace DNS, endpoints, CNI, PVC and mount path

components.name: Root cause + mitigation
components.description: Apply safe change, verify recovery and record learning

operational_steps: Check node health and scheduling constraints
Inspect logs, probes and resource pressure
Trace service, DNS, endpoints and storage
Mitigate, verify recovery and document RCA
failure_checkpoint: Incident spans multiple layers and symptoms are misleading
recovery_path: Start from user impact, correlate events/logs/metrics, isolate the failing layer and verify mitigation.
